description: This file defines the TrackerManager class which manages tracker monitors within the SuiteCRM application. It includes singleton pattern instantiation, monitor retrieval, configuration setup, and pause/unpause control for tracking, indicating it is a core component handling tracker management logic.

classes.name: TrackerManager
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for managing tracker monitors, including instantiation, configuration, enabling/disabling, and lifecycle control within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Private constructor that loads tracker configuration and initializes monitor id.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Private method to initialize monitor settings based on admin configuration, disabling monitors as configured.

methods.name: setMonitorId
methods.description: Sets a specific monitor id for all managed monitors.

methods.name: getMonitorId
methods.description: Returns the current monitor id managed by this instance.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Singleton accessor to retrieve the sole instance of TrackerManager.

methods.name: getMonitor
methods.description: Retrieves a monitor instance by name, returning a blank monitor if not configured or disabled.

methods.name: _getMonitor
methods.description: Internal method to instantiate a monitor class based on naming, checking for custom versions and defaulting if none found.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves all active monitors, particularly the tracker sessions.

methods.name: saveMonitor
methods.description: Saves a specific monitor instance and optionally clears it from the manager.

methods.name: isPaused
methods.description: Checks whether tracking is currently paused.

methods.name: getDisabledMonitors
methods.description: Returns a list of monitors that are disabled according to configuration.

methods.name: setDisabledMonitors
methods.description: Sets the list of monitors to be disabled.

methods.name: unsetMonitors
methods.description: Removes all monitors from the current manager instance.
